verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for a realtime communications platform, for example recurring meetings or scheduled recordings, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Cloudflare Realtime can schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Event-triggered features (signed backend events, an AI summary when a meeting ends) are one-off reactions rather than recurring schedules, and Workers or Durable Objects are host-platform capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
